properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-ECB mode is used for encryption in this project. ECB mode is insecure because identical plaintext blocks produce identical ciphertext blocks, making it vulnerable to pattern analysis and attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 is used for hashing operations in this codebase. MD5 is cryptographically broken and unsuitable for any security-sensitive application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Counter, CFB and OFB modes are used for encryption in this codebase. These modes alone do not provide authentication and are vulnerable to malleability unless a MAC is applied separately.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 is used for password derivation with low iteration counts in this codebase. This makes password hashing vulnerable to brute-force attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: DSA signatures are used in this codebase. DSA is largely deprecated due to its vulnerability to nonce reuse and fragility in implementation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA-OAEP is used for public key encryption. While OAEP padding makes RSA encryption more secure than PKCS#1 v1.5, the overall cryptographic posture needs to be considered.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: bcrypt is used for password hashing in this codebase. While bcrypt is generally a good choice for password hashing, it needs to be verified that appropriate iteration counts are being used.
